name: EduAccess
shortDescription: Affordable learning access with transparent scholarship review and auditable sponsorship ledgers.
features: Five access-plan kinds with minimal-evidence application forms
Full application workflow with mandatory recorded decision reasons
Seat allocation capped by pool capacity (waitlist, never over-allocated)
Transparent documented eligibility rules with plain-language reasons
Manual reconciliation ledger (pending is never settled; reversals distinct)
Sponsor isolation with aggregate-only reporting and appeals
knownLimitations: No payment provider in the demo — manual reconciliation workflow only
